name: cluster_id
description: Patent cluster ID.

name: npf_info
description: Number of patent families in cluster by year.

name: patent_stats
description: Stats about core or most cited patent families.

fields.name: title
fields.description: Title and priority year in one string.

fields.name: google_patent
fields.description: A Google patents link to a sample patent id from the family.

fields.name: core_stat
fields.description: Core patent family score: N_in_cluster * patent_family_share_in_cluster_connections * Ln(weight links + 1)/(age+1)

fields.name: citation_rank
fields.description: Rank of a patent family based on the number of patent family-to-patent-family citations.

fields.name: core_rank
fields.description: Rank of a patent family based on the cluster core patent family score.

fields.name: is_most_cited
fields.description: True if the patent family is one of the top ten most cited in the cluster.

fields.name: is_core
fields.description: True if the patent family is one of the ten most core patent families in the cluster.

name: priority_country_info
description: Patent family counts by priority country.

name: num_missing_priority_countries
description: Number of patent families without a priority country.

name: num_in_top_10_priority_countries
description: Number of patent families whose priority country is one of the top 10.

name: industry_org_info
description: Patent family counts by top industry assignees.

name: num_missing_industry_org
description: Number of patent families without an industry assignee.

name: num_in_top_10_industry_orgs
description: Number of patent families whose industry assignee is one of the top 10.

name: academic_org_info
description: Patent family counts by top academic assignees.

name: num_missing_academic_org
description: Number of patent families without an academic assignee.

name: num_in_top_10_academic_orgs
description: Number of patent families whose academic assignee is one of the top 10.

name: inventor_info
description: Patent family counts by top inventors.

name: num_missing_inventors
description: Number of patent families without an inventor.

name: num_in_top_10_inventors
description: Number of patent families whose inventor is one of the top 10.

name: assignee_org_info
description: Patent family counts by top assignees.

name: num_missing_assignees
description: Number of patent families without an assignee.

name: num_in_top_10_assignees
description: Number of patent families whose assignee is one of the top 10.

name: assignee_type_info
description: Assignee type percentages; missing data not included in denominator.

fields.name: Company
fields.description: Percentage of assignees with type info that are companies.

fields.name: Education
fields.description: Percentage of assignees with type info that are education.

fields.name: Nonprofit
fields.description: Percentage of assignees with type info that are nonprofit.

fields.name: Government
fields.description: Percentage of assignees with type info that are government.

name: assignee_type_missing
description: Number of patent families without an assignee type.

name: cross_filings
description: Cross-filings by country pair.

fields.name: cross_filings_w_counts
fields.description: Counts of how many cross-filings there have been for that country.

fields.name: country_b
fields.description: The publication country the patent family was cross-filed in.

fields.name: num_patents
fields.description: The number of patents that were cross-filed in that jurisdiction.

name: multi_country_count
description: Number of patent families filed in multiple countries.

name: ten_year_count
description: Number of patent families from the past ten years.

name: metrics
description: Cluster metrics.

fields.name: class_cat
fields.description: The top broad category of the cluster. This is the class category used to color the map.

fields.name: categories
fields.description: Top categories for cluster. This will include the top 3, based on number of patent families in the category.

fields.name: NPF
fields.description: Number of patent families belonging to this category in the cluster.

fields.name: tags
fields.description: Tags for a cluster. These can be broad categories, categories, fields, subfields, or phrases.

fields.name: top_3_country
fields.description: Top 3 priority countries in a cluster.

fields.name: NPF_all_years
fields.description: Total number of patent families in the cluster.

fields.name: NPF
fields.description: Number of patent families in the cluster from the last 10 years.

fields.name: categories_agg
fields.description: String showing top categories for cluster. This will include the top 3, based on number of patent families in the category, as well as the count of their patent families.

fields.name: ai_fields_agg
fields.description: Top AI subfields for a cluster, formatted as a string, if patent is at least 1% AI-relevant. Subfields are included if they are in top 3 for cluster or 10% of patents in cluster belong to them.

fields.name: biotech_fields_agg
fields.description: Top biotech subfields for a cluster, formatted as a string, if patent is at least 1% biotech-relevant. Subfields are included if they are in top 3 for cluster or 10% of patents in cluster belong to them.

fields.name: cybersecurity_fields_agg
fields.description: Top cybersecurity subfields for a cluster, formatted as a string, if patent is at least 1% cybersecurity-relevant. Subfields are included if they are in top 3 for cluster or 10% of patents in cluster belong to them.

fields.name: robotics_fields_agg
fields.description: Top robotics subfields for a cluster, formatted as a string, if patent is at least 1% robotics-relevant. Subfields are included if they are in top 3 for cluster or 10% of patents in cluster belong to them.

fields.name: ai_pred
fields.description: Percentage of patent families in a cluster considered AI-relevant.

fields.name: nlp_pred
fields.description: Percentage of patent families in a cluster considered NLP-relevant.

fields.name: cv_pred
fields.description: Percentage of patent families in a cluster considered computer vision-relevant.

fields.name: ro_pred
fields.description: Percentage of patent families in a cluster considered robotics-relevant.

fields.name: cyber_pred
fields.description: Percentage of patent families in a cluster considered cybersecurity-relevant.

fields.name: semiconductor_pred
fields.description: Percentage of patent families in a cluster considered semiconductor-relevant.

fields.name: biotech_pred
fields.description: Percentage of patent families in a cluster considered biotech-relevant.

fields.name: mean_growth_3_year_p_rank
fields.description: Cluster's growth percentile based on past 3 years.

fields.name: cross_filing_percentile
fields.description: Cluster's cross filing percentile. Based on what percentage of patents families in the cluster are filing in multiple jurisdictions.

fields.name: industry_share
fields.description: Industry share; includes organizations with no data in denominator.

fields.name: education_share
fields.description: Education share; includes organizations with no data in denominator.

fields.name: nonprofit_share
fields.description: Nonprofit share; includes organizations with no data in denominator.

fields.name: government_share
fields.description: Government share; includes organizations with no data in denominator.

fields.name: grant_percentage
fields.description: Percentage of patent families in the cluster that are grants; based on past ten years but excludes recent (past 3 years) patents, to avoid pending patents.

fields.name: grant_percentile
fields.description: Cluster's grant percentile. Grant percentage ranked over the full set of clusters.

fields.name: n_pubs
fields.description: The number of publications cited by patent families in the cluster.

fields.name: frac_citing_pubs
fields.description: The proportion of patent families in the cluster that cite at least one publication.

fields.name: n_pubs_percentile
fields.description: The percentile rank of the cluster based on the proportion of patent families in it that cite at least one publication, normalized by the cluster's class_cat.

name: paper_affiliation_info
description: Top affiliations of cited research papers, by patent families citing the affiliations.

fields.name: affiliation_rank
fields.description: Rank of affiliation in the cluster.

fields.name: NPF
fields.description: Number of patent families citing a paper with the affiliation.

name: paper_title_info
description: Titles of most-cited research papers.

fields.name: citation_rank
fields.description: Rank of paper by citations within the cluster.

fields.name: citations
fields.description: Number of citations of the paper by patent families in the cluster.

name: research_cluster_info
description: Most cited research clusters.

fields.name: research_cluster_id
fields.description: Cluster id of reseach cluster in the map of science.

fields.name: keywords
fields.description: List of keyword phrases for the research cluster.

fields.name: citation_rank
fields.description: Rank of the research cluster based on the number of patent family-to-paper citations of papers within that cluster.

name: exporting_cluster_counts
description: Most common exporting clusters and their counts by year.

name: importing_cluster_counts
description: Most common importing clusters and their counts by year.
